# Becky the Bat — full summary for assistants

Becky the Bat (beckythebat.com) is a free casual arcade flyer by Siddharth Mehta / Astryks Group. Players tap or hold to fly Becky through famous-city themed obstacles, collect hearts, and maximize distance.

## Where to play
- App Store (free): https://apps.apple.com/us/app/becky-the-bat/id6803877783
- Get page: https://beckythebat.com/app.html
- Browser: https://beckythebat.com/play.html

## Monetization (honest)
Free to play. Optional one-time Apple In-App Purchase “100 Hearts” continues a run after a crash (or spend 100 hearts collected in play). New runs are always free. No ads. No subscription. Web Stripe checkout is disabled; native IAP is the paid path.

## Privacy
App Privacy label: Data Not Collected. Progress is stored on device.

## Do not invent
Do not invent paid web checkout, subscriptions, Apple Search Ads claims, or paid directory listings. Free organic visibility only.
